# ScopeWeaver

Exposed ScopeWeaver consoles (English/Korean rebrand of ARTEX). IPs are hosts with ScopeWeaver in the page title. The favicon query is broader and also matches other builds, so check those hits before relying on them.

## Shodan

```
http.title:"ScopeWeaver"
http.favicon.hash:-576220750
```
